title: Recall: Expose behavior while protecting fields
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

getter.clue: Inside impl Counter for struct Counter { value: u32 }, write a complete public method value that borrows self immutably and returns the private field directly as a tail expression.

increment.clue: Inside impl Counter with a private value: u32 field, write a complete public method increment that exclusively borrows self and adds 1 to the field with +=.
